Contents.Html:
Welcome to your cCoder platform

Your new platform is ready, and this is the starting point for shaping it around the people, content and processes it will support.

Everything begins in administration

Open the administration area to configure the application, manage users and access, and explore the capabilities included in your baseline.

  • Set up the application experience, themes and reusable content.
  • Manage platform users, roles and identity security.
  • Explore documents, workflows, shared resources and operational tools.
Open administrationRead the documentation

Build from a working foundation

The baseline gives you a clean, reusable platform rather than a finished application. Start with the administration area, keep the documentation close, and evolve the experience as your requirements become clear.
